mapper.select: SELECT member_no, member_id, name, nick_name, email, phone_number, zip_code, basic_address, detail_address, gender, birthday, created_at, purchase_count, bank_name, bank_code, account_holder_name, status FROM member WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET name = #{name}, nick_name = #{nickName}, email = #{email}, phone_number = #{phoneNumber}, gender = #{gender}, birthday = #{birthday}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, basic_address = #{basicAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, bank_name = #{bankName}, bank_code = #{bankCode}, account_holder_name = #{accountHolderName} WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: SELECT memo_no, member_no, content, created_at FROM member_memo WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_memo (memo_no, member_no, content, created_at) VALUES (seq_memo.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{content}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT mc.member_coupon_no AS "memberCouponNo", c.coupon_name AS "couponName", c.discount_type AS "discountType", c.discount_value AS "discountValue", mc.used_yn AS "usedYn", TO_CHAR(mc.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "startAt", TO_CHAR(mc.end_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "endAt", TO_CHAR(mc.issued_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "issuedAt" FROM member_coupon mc JOIN coupon c ON mc.coupon_no = c.coupon_no WHERE mc.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY mc.issued_at DESC
SELECT coupon_no, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value FROM coupon WHERE delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon (coupon_no, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, delete_yn, created_at) VALUES (seq_coupon.NEXTVAL, #{couponName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, 'N', SYSTIMESTAMP)
